parameters.content:
## What this does
Fires when Documenso reports a signed proposal. Promotes the Krayin lead to Won, spins up the delivery project, sends a kickoff email.

For the first 10 signed deals: posts a human-approval Slack button to #sales-pipeline. After 10, can switch to fully automatic via env var ONBOARDING_AUTO_APPROVE=true.

Flow:
1. Webhook: Documenso POST to /webhook/documenso/signed
2. Verify HMAC signature (header X-Documenso-Signature) against DOCUMENSO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
3. Extract lead_id from envelope metadata
4. Fetch lead + sku from Krayin/warehouse
5. Branch on ONBOARDING_AUTO_APPROVE:
   - false (default): Slack interactive approval button; pause until clicked
   - true: proceed automatically
6. Krayin: stage → Won (stage_id 20)
7. Plane: create project from SKU-specific template
8. Brevo: kickoff email to client
9. Drive: create /clients/<company>/ folder structure
10. Slack #client-success: announce

## KPI
Time-to-signature (median) tracked in cost-per-booked-call dashboard. < 5 business days target.

## Open-question default (spec §10/4)
Default behavior for v1: require human approval. Flip when comfortable.

See UNDERWINGS-MASTER-PLAN.md §7/C and §7/E.

parameters.query: SELECT l.id AS lead_id, l.title, l.lead_value, o.name AS organization_name, p.name AS person_name, p.emails AS person_emails FROM raw.leads l LEFT JOIN raw.organizations o ON o.id = l.organization_id LEFT JOIN raw.persons p ON p.id = l.person_id WHERE l.id = $1;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: `🎉 *${$('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref}* signed by *${$json.organization_name}* — please confirm onboarding manually in n8n, or approve here when interactive Slack is set up.` }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $('fetch-lead-context').first().json.lead_id, stage_id: 20, note: `Won — proposal ${$('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref} signed` }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ name: `${$('fetch-lead-context').first().json.organization_name} — ${$('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref}`, identifier: $('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref.replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 12), description: `Delivery project for ${$('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref}. Lead #${$('fetch-lead-context').first().json.lead_id}.` }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ sender: { name: 'Underwings', email: 'contact@underwings.org' }, to: [{ email: $('fetch-lead-context').first().json.person_emails, name: $('fetch-lead-context').first().json.person_name }], subject: `Welcome aboard — ${$('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref}`, htmlContent: `

Hi ${$('fetch-lead-context').first().json.person_name},

Thank you for signing ${$('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref}. Our delivery team will be in touch within 2 business days to schedule the kickoff call.

In the meantime, your invoice for the first milestone is on its way separately.

— Underwings Cybersecurity

` }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ text: `🚀 *New client onboarded* — ${$('fetch-lead-context').first().json.organization_name} (${$('verify-hmac').first().json.proposal_ref}). Plane project created. Kickoff email sent. Next: schedule kickoff call.` }) }}
